findings.reason: the open node `jtmm-tokamap-jt60sa` would add the public COCOS resolver to `imas_ambix/data/transform_engine.py`, and the open §6 EQDB nodes would add the request/record/refusal types and the grid writer/reader to `imas_ambix/data/eddb_remote.py` and `imas_ambix/data/eddb.py`, none of which exist at those paths, so each node blocks on a missing file or forks a second engine; every reference must be repointed at the imas-alambic owner before the nodes are released.
findings.text: the plan names eight engine modules under `imas_ambix/data/` that commit 3ae87c26 carved into the imas-alambic workspace member (`packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/`, no compat re-export exists): `imas_ambix/data/transform_engine.py` at plan lines 214 and 275 (owner now `imas_alambic/transform_engine.py`, where `_target_cocos_transformation` and `_apply_cocos_convention` live at lines 411/447); `imas_ambix/cocos.py` at 276, 293 and 1732 (owner `imas_alambic/cocos.py`); `imas_ambix/data/eddb_remote.py` at 231 and 720 (owner `imas_alambic/eddb_remote.py`); `imas_ambix/data/eddb.py` at 231 and 736 (owner `imas_alambic/eddb.py`); `imas_ambix/data/virtual_zarr.py` at 409 (owner `imas_alambic/virtual_zarr.py`, `raw_series` at line 146); `imas_ambix/data/pulse_mint.py` at 416 and 1268 (owner `imas_alambic/pulse_mint.py`); `imas_ambix/data/signal_map.py` at 1206 (owner `imas_alambic/signal_map.py`); `imas_ambix/data/machine_map.py` at 1528 (owner `imas_alambic/machine_map.py`).

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §6 and §7 each extend one deep module (the remote extractor; the SELENE loader seam) rather than adding a parallel one, and the machine is threaded through the existing resolvers instead of a new selector.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — the plan names the one real duplicate (`tokamap_export._cocos_transformation` beside `transform_engine._target_cocos_transformation`, plan §2) and extends owners (`eddb.channel_path`, `eddb_remote`, `machine_identity.default_registry`, `gs/artifact_resolution.py`) rather than forking them.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; each section that adds public surface (§2 one resolver, §6 three EQDB types plus two `BatchResult` fields, §7 one machine-keyed pin/shotset table) names what it retires or states why nothing can be retired, and no CLI option, MCP view or refusal family is added.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan's reuse map is thorough and accurate for the mechanisms it cites (tokamap, `cocos_convention.score_convention`, `eval/efit_referee.judge_geometry`, `worldmodel.equilibrium_labels.build_geometry_from_arrays`), but the eight engine modules it names as the files to extend were carved out of `imas_ambix/data/` into the `imas-alambic` workspace member, so the paths the open nodes would edit no longer exist.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — each section that adds a layer (the SELENE reference loader, the EQDB request/record/refusal types, the tokamap exporter) states in its own text why the existing machinery cannot carry the new shape.
